name: Patrick Schwarzenegger
bio:
Patrick Arnold Shriver Schwarzenegger (born September 18, 1993) is an American actor. He is the son of Arnold Schwarzenegger and Maria Shriver. He began his career playing minor roles in the early 2000s and has since starred in the television series The Staircase (2022), American Sports Story (2024), and the third season of The White Lotus (2025).
